description: Instructional figure for lesson alg8-c2-s2-n10: closed strip between the two solid slope-2 parallel boundary lines. Source cell dimensions, integer phase, source labels and boundary inclusion are retained.

authoritativeText.text:
我们来讨论二元不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}y&\geqslant x,\\x^2+y^2&\leqslant9.\end{aligned}\right.$
这个不等式组的解集合是其中各不等式的解集合的交集。
我们来看看，以所讨论的不等式组的解为坐标的平面上点的集合是什么。

坐标满足不等式$y\geqslant x$的点的集合，是直线$y=x$上的点的集合与这条直线上方的开半平面上的点的集合的并集（图22中用水平细线表示）。
坐标满足不等式$x^2+y^2\leqslant9$的点的集合，是圆心在坐标原点、半径为3的圆形区域，包含内部和边界（图22中用铅直细线表示）。

一个点的坐标满足这个不等式组，当且仅当这个点属于这两个点集的交集。
图22中，两种细线重叠的区域就是这两个点集的交集。
这就是说，所讨论的不等式组给出一个包含内部和边界的半圆形区域。

例1：考察不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}x&\leqslant0,\\y&\geqslant0\end{aligned}\right.$
它给出第二象限及其在坐标轴上的边界，包含坐标原点（图23）。

例2：考察不等式组：
$\left\{\begin{aligned}y&\geqslant2x-3,\\y&\leqslant2x+2\end{aligned}\right.$
它给出以直线$y=2x-3$和$y=2x+2$为边界的带形区域，包含两条边界直线（图24）。

inventory.description: Exactly 12 columns by 18 rows, integer phase; origin left5/right7/top11/bottom7. It is neither square nor centered. Source bounds [-5,11,7,-7], steps [1,1], offsets [0,0]; origin left/right/above/below [5,7,11,7].

One shared axis frame with positive arrows, origin/x/y and two unit labels; y-unit 1 is on the RIGHT of the y axis. Original labels and sides: 0: Immediately southwest of the axes intersection, below x axis and left of y axis, inside the hatched strip. x: Near positive x end, below horizontal axis and right of the arrowhead. y: Near positive y end, left of vertical axis. 1: Below the x axis at x=1, the first coarse line right of origin, inside the strip. 1: RIGHT of the y axis at y=1, the first coarse line above origin, inside the strip. This is not the left-side placement of fig-23.
Two included solid slope-2 parallels, upper y=2x+2 and lower y=2x-3; preserve line-label associations and half-cell lower x intercept.

SW-to-NE hatching confined to the strip, shallower than the boundaries. The graph's origin is inside the strip. Original shading: Parallel oblique strokes rising southwest to northeast (/), shallower than the two boundary lines; NOT parallel to those boundaries; Only the closed strip 2x-3<=y<=2x+2 within frame. No hatching outside the two lines. No deliberate dashed boundary.
